name: Rolling afrobeat bass
desc: A rolling, syncopated sawtooth afrobeat bass in the Fela pocket — root/fifth/third figures walking a I-vi-IV-V (E C#m A B) progression bar by bar, under a slow 16-cycle filter breath. Peak gallops in octaves with an isaw pump.

code.full: note('<[e2 ~ b1 e2 ~ g#1 b1 ~ e2 ~ b1 ~] [c#2 ~ g#1 c#2 ~ e2 g#1 ~ c#2 ~ g#1 ~] [a1 ~ e2 a1 ~ c#2 e2 ~ a1 ~ e2 ~] [b1 ~ f#2 b1 ~ d#2 f#2 ~ b1 ~ f#2 ~]>').add(note(${root})).s('sawtooth').lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6,${cut}*1.5).slow(16)).lpq(4).decay(.2).sustain(.15).shape(${drive}).gain(${gain}).room(.12).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note('<[e2 b1 e2 b2 g#1 b1 e2 g#1 e2 b1 e2 b2] [c#2 g#1 c#2 g#2 e2 g#1 c#2 e2 c#2 g#1 c#2 g#2] [a1 e2 a1 e2 c#2 e2 a1 c#2 a1 e2 a1 e2] [b1 f#2 b1 f#2 d#2 f#2 b1 d#2 b1 f#2 b1 f#2]>').add(note(${root})).s('sawtooth').ftype('24db').lpf(sine.range(${cut},${cut}*1.8).slow(12)).lpq(5).decay(.16).sustain(.1).shape(${drive}).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.55,${gain}).fast(4)).room(.12).orbit(3).play()
